page.description: Armbian for UEFI x86: minimal, GNOME and KDE images with sizes and publisher .sha sidecars.
page.intro: A Debian-based build system for small boards and, here, UEFI x86 machines. The images are compressed disk images written to a stick or drive.
pros: Debian-based with Armbian's own configuration tool, armbian-config.
Minimal, GNOME and KDE images from the same 26.8.3 build.
Per-image .sha sidecars are published on the mirror.
Works as a small server or desktop on UEFI x86 hardware.
cons: These are disk images (.img.xz), not ISOs.
Most Armbian work targets single-board computers; x86 is a side channel.
The version is the build date (26.8.3, 2026-08-03).
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Armbian; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One compressed disk image per desktop variant, written with dd or any image writer to a stick or drive. Writing replaces the whole device. The version is the build date (26.8.3, 2026-08-03).
